posted.text:
:tada: *lantern v2.4.0 is out.* <https://github.com/acme/lantern/releases/tag/v2.4.0|Release notes>
Dashboards export to PDF now.
• Export any dashboard to PDF from File > Export, one page per row (#101)
• Signing in on Safari 17 no longer loops back to the login page (#104)
• Heads up: the CLI now needs Node 20 or later (#107)
4 pull requests from 2 people and a bot. Thanks mira-k and jon-b.
